name: anchor
description: Desktop focus anchor: a Nemotron agent judges every window you switch to and pulls you back when you drift.

scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-packager . Anchor --out=release --overwrite --icon=build/icon.icns --app-bundle-id=com.anchor.app --extend-info=build/Info.extend.plist --ignore=^/server --ignore=^/src --ignore=^/scripts --ignore=^/release --no-asar && sh scripts/sign-mac.sh && echo '\nBuilt: '$(ls -d release/Anchor-darwin-*/Anchor.app)
